name: mecddi-query
description: Query the MecDDI mechanism-based drug-drug interaction database. Use whenever the user asks about drug-drug interactions, DDI mechanisms (PK/PD), enzyme or transporter-mediated interactions, or wants to look up interacting drug pairs by drug name or MecDDI drug ID. Trigger on keywords like DDI, drug interaction, MecDDI, mechanism-based interaction, pharmacokinetic interaction, pharmacodynamic interaction, or any query involving two drugs that may interact.
